def VTask.strongDownwardInduction : {α : Type u_1} -> {p : Finset α → Sort u_4} -> {n : ℕ} -> (H : (t₁ : Finset α) → ({t₂ : Finset α} → t₂.card ≤ n → t₁ ⊂ t₂ → p t₂) → t₁.card ≤ n → p t₁) -> (s : Finset α) -> s.card ≤ n → p s := by
  intro α p n H s hs
  have h : ∀ (s : Finset α), s.card ≤ n → p s := by
    intro s
    have h₁ : ∀ (c : ℕ), ∀ (s : Finset α), s.card = c → c ≤ n → p s := by
      intro c
      -- Use strong induction on c
      induction' c using Nat.strong_induction_on with c ih
      intro s hc hcn
      -- Apply the given step function H to s
      have h₂ : p s := H s (fun {t₂} ht₂ hst₂ => by
        -- For any strict superset t₂ of s with t₂.card ≤ n, use the induction hypothesis
        have h₃ : t₂.card ≤ n := ht₂
        have h₄ : s ⊂ t₂ := hst₂
        have h₅ : t₂.card > s.card := Finset.card_lt_card h₄
        have h₆ : t₂.card = c + (t₂.card - s.card) := by
          have h₇ : s.card ≤ t₂.card := by
            have h₈ : s ⊆ t₂ := Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mp h₄ |>.1
            exact Finset.card_le_of_subset h₈
          omega
        have h₇ : t₂.card - s.card > 0 := by
          have h₈ : s.card < t₂.card := Finset.card_lt_card h₄
          omega
        have h₈ : c + (t₂.card - s.card) > c := by omega
        have h₉ : t₂.card > c := by omega
        have h₁₀ : t₂.card ≤ n := ht₂
        have h₁₁ : t₂.card < n + 1 := by omega
        have h₁₂ : p t₂ := ih (t₂.card) (by omega) t₂ (by simp [ht₂]) (by omega)
        exact h₁₂
      ) (by
        -- Prove that s.card ≤ n
        have h₃ : s.card = c := hc
        have h₄ : c ≤ n := hcn
        omega
      )
      exact h₂
    -- Use the above result to get p s
    have h₂ : s.card ≤ n := hs
    have h₃ : p s := h₁ s.card s (by rfl) h₂
    exact h₃
  -- Apply the above result to s
  exact h s hs
